summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine PDMR share transactions under the company's Share Reward Plan. Multiple executives (President Europe, CFO, SVP & Group General Counsel, President Corporate Development, President Global Supply Chain) each acquired 14 ordinary shares at £18.8393 per share on June 9, 2026, via partnership and matching shares. This is a standard equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. No deal structure, premium, or strategic event is present. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of insider trading activity with no market-moving implications or risk-arb angle.
